Photos shared by people and public bodie: Izithombe ezabiwe ngabantu nezikhungo zikahulumeni, ngaphansi kwamalayisense avulekile (ikakhulukazi i-CC BY-SA 4.0 noma i-Etalab 2.0) avumela ukwenza amamephu ngazo. Bonga umthwebuli uma usebenzisa esisodwa.
Street-level photos from Panoramax, the: Izithombe zezinga lomgwaqo ezivela ku-Panoramax, ingcebo yomphakathi yamahhala nevulekile yezithombe zemigwaqo. Vula Izithombe zemigwaqo emephini ukuze ubone lapho izithombe zathathwa khona, bese uchofoza iphoyinti ukuze ubone izithombe ezathathwa eduze kwalo. Izithombe zingaphansi kwamalayisense avulekile avumela ukwenza amamephu ngazo. Akudingeki ukhiye. Izithombe zidlula kule MobSimLab futhi azigcinwa noma zilondolozwe nephrojekthi.
